title: Video storyboard
description: A video as a clock, slots on that clock, every take made for each slot, and the picks at each checkpoint. Paths that start with media/ point into a folder that is not shipped; the page plays them only when the viewer supplies that folder. Any other relative path ships beside the page.

aspect.description: Frame shape of the video, such as 16:9 or 9:16.

assets.description: Takes that sit off the clock: character sheets, start frames, ranked candidates, stills that feed a slot.

checkpoints.description: Oldest first. The last one is the shipped cut, and take status follows from it.

mediaPath.description: media/<path> is private and resolves against the viewer's media folder or the ?media= base. Any other relative path ships beside the page.

source.description: A public place to watch the material: a URL and the second it starts at.

kind.description: reference: a remade video's own audio is the clock. song: a song's beat grid is. voiceover: a spoken track is, and its lines are the landmarks.

reference.description: What the clock follows: the remade video, the song, or the voiceover. Required when kind is reference.

offset_s.description: Reference time at clock 0. A timestamp link for clock time t points at offset_s + t.

media.description: The reference video inside the media folder, played by takes with plays_reference.

audio.description: Audio files that can drive the clock, best first. With none available the page runs a silent clock.

sections.description: Named stretches of the clock: song sections, acts, chapters.

t0.description: Edges on the last checkpoint that holds the slot. Other checkpoints move them with bounds.

section.description: Label of the clock section the slot sits in.

verdict.description: keep: copy the reference span. overlay: draw text or graphics over it. swap: video-to-video with a new subject. render: a code-rendered insert. replace: new footage in place of the reference's. found: footage from elsewhere cut to the clock with no reference shot behind it. filmed: the maker's own camera footage.

source.description: Where the reference's version of this slot can be watched.

series.description: A measured strip over the take's own time, drawn as a sparkline in place of pixels.

t0.description: Seconds into the take of the first value. Default 0.

threshold.description: A line drawn across the strip, such as a cut score limit.

id.description: Unique within its slot, or among assets.

cost_usd.description: Billed generation cost. null when the take ran locally or the cost was not logged.

status.description: picked: in the last checkpoint. superseded: picked at an earlier checkpoint only. rejected: made or found for the cut, never picked. lab: an experiment off the cut's path. failed: the request returned no output.

prompt_file.description: A shipped prompt or recipe file, relative to the page.

plays_reference.description: The take is the reference itself: play clock.reference.media at clock time.

source.description: A public link to the material the take is cut from, at the second it starts.

span.description: The part of the video that fills the slot, in seconds of the file. Default: the whole file, stretched to the slot.

frames.description: Frame facts: how many frames the take fills on the clock, and the first and last frames a generator was given.

cuts.description: Shots inside the take, on slot time (seconds from the slot's t0). With span set, the page plays that part of the take's video for the cut.

public.description: true only when the take's media may ship. Metadata always ships.

used_by.description: Assets only: the slots this asset feeds.

picks.description: slot id to take id. A slot left out is not in this checkpoint. Leave picks out entirely when the checkpoint's per-slot record was not kept.

bounds.description: slot id to [t0, t1] where this checkpoint's slot edges differ from the slot's own.

duration_s.description: This checkpoint's length when it differs from the clock's.

sections.description: This checkpoint's own sections, when the clock was rebuilt for it (an original video re-cuts its song).

audio.description: This checkpoint's own mix, when the clock was rebuilt for it.
